permitted: estado latente de evidencia u orientacion observable
terminology.prohibited_claim: camera or model directly measures internal attention
terminology.no_observable_rule: explicit state; never distraction, negative class, zero or imputation

retained_hypotheses.statement: The linear slope of F1_tarea across 14 phases differs from zero.
retained_hypotheses.analysis: mixed model: F1_tarea ~ phase_index + (1 + phase_index|participant); frozen v0.1 simplification rule retained

temporal_estimands.formula: sum(window_duration) within each maximal contiguous run of the same observable state
elapsed time from onset of observable off-task episode to two consecutive observable on-task windows

noise_separation.attribution_rule: change adjacent to a break is not attributed to participant dynamics

M1.no_observable: excluded from binary classification and retained in coverage denominators
M1.threshold_selection: on development data only, choose the lowest threshold meeting sensitivity >= 0.70 and specificity >= 0.80; fail if none; never optimize on holdout
M1.interpretation_limit: classification of observable orientation; not internal attention

wave6_alignment.PR24: GRU or LSTM baseline under identical splits, signals and metrics
